newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Pacific takes stake in PT Metrosel. [CORRECTED 02:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: First Pacific takes stake in PT Metrosel. [CORRECTED 02:15 GMT]

text.p: First Pacific Company Ltd is to acquire a stake in an Indonesian mobile cellular telecommunications operator through its subsidiary Asia Link B.V., First Pacific said in announcement published on Thursday.

Asia Link, a wholly owned subsidiary of First Pacific, signed an agreement on Wednesday to take a 35 percent stake in the enlarged and outstanding share capital of PT Metro Selular Nusantara (Metrosel) for HK$1.14 billion, the announcement said.
Metrosel is a licensed mobile cellular operator in Indonesia, whose cellular licence and growth prospects have been valued at HK$3.25 billion, the announcement added.

Metrosel, formed in November 1995, is licensed to provide services in Indonesia's central and east Java regions, Irian Jaya and Maluku, which encompasses the major urban centres of Surabaya and Semarang with a combined population of 71 million (corrects from 17 million) people, the announcement said.
Metrosel has net assets of HK$162 million.
The deal should be concluded before March 31, 1997, the announcement said.
Asia Link has cellular telecommunications ventures in Hong Kong, the Philippines, India and China.
